roadmap.title: Base Game Story & Mission Run
roadmap.description: Play regions 1-7 and clear all 20 main and 53 side missions. Grab Kodama, hot springs and hidden map items as you explore, dispel Dark Realms when you find them, and pick up the easy blacksmith, shrine and co-op unlocks so the post-game cleanup stays short.

roadmap.title: Base Game Cleanup & Weapon Mastery
roadmap.description: After the story, replay missions to finish Kodama, hot springs, Soul Cores, yokai and Guardian Spirits, farm the 50 tea utensils and 30 Dungballs, and grind 120,000+ proficiency per weapon plus Ninjutsu and Onmyo Magic so you can clear the Veteran dojo missions and buy every mystic art.

roadmap.title: The Tengu's Disciple (DLC 1)
roadmap.description: Play the DLC 1 missions A Song to Calm the Storm, Eternal Rivals and Shadows Creep in Kurama. Collect its 25 Kodama and 3 hot springs, gather Saigyo's poetry cards, use the three giant bows, clear the golden mine shards, knock Yoshitsune off his perch, and grind splitstaff proficiency.

roadmap.title: Darkness in the Capital (DLC 2)
roadmap.description: Play the DLC 2 missions Suzune in the Flames, The Blighted Gate, Palace of the Damned and The Dragon's Kin. Collect its 25 Kodama and 4 hot springs, light every fire altar, beat Tsuchigumo wearing Dragon Ninja gear, force Amrita from Oboroguruma, complete the Stone of Penance, and grind fists proficiency.

roadmap.title: The First Samurai (DLC 3)
roadmap.description: Play the DLC 3 missions Dawn of the Demon, A Distant Dream and the side missions. Collect its 25 Kodama and 5 hot springs, save the Mujina, destroy the four demons, gather Kukai's brushes, use a holy-water cask, and finally clear Against All Comers on Dream of the Demon or higher.

roadmap.title: Platinum Completion
roadmap.description: With every base and DLC achievement unlocked, collect the final You Are Nioh platinum.

achievements.description: You have unlocked all achievements!
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in the Complete Edition, including the three DLC expansions.

guide.context: The Steam achievement list includes The Tengu's Disciple, Darkness in the Capital and The First Samurai DLC achievements, so all three expansions must be finished as well as the base game.

steps.text: Unlock all 87 other achievements in @item{Nioh 2 – The Complete Edition}.

achievements.description: Reached level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Defeat enemies to earn @item{Amrita}, pray at a @loc{Shrine}, and spend the Amrita to raise your character level to 10.

achievements.description: Reached level 100.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 100.

guide.context: The level comes naturally near the end of the story when the side missions are played, so no Amrita farming is required.

steps.text: Keep earning @item{Amrita} from enemies and mission rewards and spend it at a @loc{Shrine} until your character level reaches 100.

achievements.description: Befriended Tokichiro.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms} and befriend Tokichiro.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms}; the achievement unlocks after the mission as you befriend @npc{Tokichiro}.

achievements.description: Defeated Imagawa Yoshimoto and was made a samurai.
achievements.summary: Defeat Imagawa Yoshimoto in @loc{The Hidden Monsters of Okehazama} to be made a samurai.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Hidden Monsters of Okehazama} by defeating its boss @enemy{Imagawa Yoshimoto}.

achievements.description: Decided to share a name with Tokichiro.
achievements.summary: Agree to share the name Hideyoshi with Tokichiro when the story enters the Shadow region.

guide.context: This plays out automatically in the cutscene that moves the story from the second region, Soaring, into the third region, Shadow.

steps.text: Progress the main story into the third region and take the name @npc{Hideyoshi} in the transition cutscene.

achievements.description: Parted ways with Tokichiro.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Sun Sets on Mount Tenno} and part ways with Tokichiro.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Sun Sets on Mount Tenno} and part ways with Tokichiro.

achievements.description: Defeated Tokichiro.
achievements.summary: Defeat Tokichiro during @loc{The Two Faces of Hospitality}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Two Faces of Hospitality} by defeating @npc{Tokichiro}.

achievements.description: Reunited with your mother in the Interim.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The High-spirited Demon} and reunite with your mother in the @loc{Interim}.

steps.text: Finish the main mission @loc{The High-spirited Demon}.

achievements.description: Fulfilled your ultimate destiny.
achievements.summary: Reach the main mission @loc{Sealed Fate} and fulfil your ultimate destiny.

steps.text: Progress to the nineteenth main mission, @loc{Sealed Fate}.

achievements.description: Saw Tokichiro off on his final departure.
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 main missions and see Tokichiro off on his final departure.

steps.text: Complete the final main mission; the achievement unlocks in the ending scene.

achievements.description: Listened to the innermost thoughts of a Yokai Weapon.
achievements.summary: Listen to every line a 999-familiarity yokai weapon speaks.

guide.context: The weapon must carry the purple @item{Imbue Corruption} stat and purple icon; 900 familiarity or lower is not enough for it to talk. The achievement waits until the weapon has exhausted its repeated dialogues, not the first time it speaks.

steps.text: Equip a yokai weapon with the purple @item{Imbue Corruption} stat and raise its familiarity to 999 by using it in combat.
Keep the weapon equipped as the @mechanic{Sentience Gauge} beneath it fills, and continue until it has spoken all of its lines.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the sword.
achievements.summary: Acquire the sword's mystic art by reaching 120,000 sword proficiency and clearing the @loc{Way of the Warrior: Veteran} dojo mission.

guide.context: Proficiency is separate from weapon familiarity and rises with the damage you deal. Patch 1.04 raised proficiency gain fourfold and lowered the weapon requirement to 120,000. A fast post-story farm is @loc{The Golden Castle} in New Game+: at the first shrine, lure the four enemies near the entrance together, kill them with a wide mid-stance attack, then pray to respawn them.

steps.text: Deal damage with the sword until its @mechanic{proficiency} reaches 120,000; check it at Touchpad > @loc{Status}.
Advance the story until the sword's Veteran dojo mission appears, then clear it.
Open Touchpad > @mechanic{Learn Skills} and buy the sword mystic art.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Ninjutsu mystic art by reaching 200,000 Ninjutsu proficiency and clearing the highest Ninjutsu dojo mission.

guide.context: Ninjutsu proficiency rises as your shuriken, bombs and other ninja tools deal damage, and it needs far more than a weapon's 120,000. Using ninjutsu during the proficiency farm for a weapon levels both at once.

steps.text: Throw ninja tools such as @item{shuriken} and @item{bombs} in combat until @mechanic{Ninjutsu proficiency} reaches 200,000.
Advance the story until the highest Ninjutsu dojo mission appears, then clear it.
Open Touchpad > @mechanic{Learn Skills} and buy the Ninjutsu mystic art.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Onmyo Magic mystic art by reaching 250,000 Onmyo Magic proficiency and clearing the highest Onmyo dojo mission.

guide.context: Onmyo Magic proficiency rises as your talismans and spells deal damage, and it needs the most of any category. Cast spells during the weapon proficiency farm so both progress together.

steps.text: Cast damaging @mechanic{Onmyo Magic} such as talismans in combat until your Onmyo proficiency reaches 250,000.
Advance the story until the highest Onmyo dojo mission appears, then clear it.
Open Touchpad > @mechanic{Learn Skills} and buy the Onmyo Magic mystic art.

achievements.description: Used the Brute, Feral, and Phantom Burst Counters five times each to counter a Burst Attack.
achievements.summary: Counter a red-aura Burst Attack five times with each Guardian Spirit style: Brute, Feral, and Phantom.

guide.context: Brute, Feral and Phantom are the three Guardian Spirit types, and each one has a different counter animation and timing window. Counters practised in dojo tutorials do not count toward the achievement.

steps.text: When an enemy charges a red-aura @mechanic{Burst Attack}, press the Burst Counter input just before the attack connects.
At a @loc{Shrine}, equip a @mechanic{Brute}, a @mechanic{Feral} and a @mechanic{Phantom} Guardian Spirit in turn and land five successful counters with each.
steps.note: The first big enemy in @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms} uses red attacks often, so you can farm the counters there.

achievements.description: Performed a Soul Match.
achievements.summary: Perform a Soul Match at the blacksmith.

steps.text: At @loc{Starting Point}'s @npc{Blacksmith}, choose @mechanic{Soul Match}, pick two pieces of gear, and confirm.

achievements.description: Forged an item.
achievements.summary: Forge any item at the blacksmith.

steps.text: Open @loc{World Map} > @loc{Starting Point} > @npc{Blacksmith} > @mechanic{Forge} and craft any weapon, piece of armor or tool.

achievements.description: Remodeled a piece of equipment.
achievements.summary: Remodel a piece of equipment that has a plus level.

guide.context: @loc{Remodel} only accepts equipment with a (+1) or higher level, and such gear drops mostly as Divine (green) equipment late in the first playthrough, so the option becomes usable near the end of the story.

steps.text: Open @loc{World Map} > @loc{Starting Point} > @npc{Blacksmith} > @mechanic{Remodel}, select a piece of gear with a (+1) or higher level, and confirm the change.

achievements.description: Appraised your tea utensils 50 times.
achievements.summary: Appraise 50 tea utensils at the Hidden Teahouse.

guide.context: Tea utensils are random enemy drops and roughly 25-40 arrive during the story. Farming a single-boss sub mission such as @loc{A Formal Match} (@enemy{Obsidian Samurai}) or @npc{William} in @loc{The Blue-eyed Samurai} is the most reliable finish; joining the tea-utensil clan and displaying high-Eccentricity utensils in the hut both raise the drop rate. Utensils the appraiser rejects still count.

steps.text: Collect tea utensils from defeated enemies until you hold enough to appraise 50.
Open @loc{World Map} > @loc{Starting Point} > @loc{Hidden Teahouse}, give the utensils to the old man, and let him appraise them.
Open Touchpad and go to @loc{Titles}; the @loc{Ungyo Title List} entry for @loc{Reputable Tea Ceremony Master} shows the count.

achievements.description: Displayed a calligraphy scroll in your hut.
achievements.summary: Display a calligraphy scroll in your hut.

guide.context: A Hanging Scroll Text costs 1000 Glory, which is earned by defeating revenants at red graves.

steps.text: At @loc{Hidden Teahouse} > @mechanic{Trade}, buy a @item{Hanging Scroll Text} for 1000 Glory.
Open @loc{Starting Point}, go to the @loc{Hut}, choose @mechanic{Remodel Hut}, then @loc{Hanging Scrolls} and @loc{Calligraphy}, and place the scroll.

achievements.description: Used the Kodama Bazaar.
achievements.summary: Buy any item from the Kodama Bazaar.

guide.context: Purchases use Divine Rice, earned by donating items at a shrine. The Bazaar only restocks an item when you hold fewer of it than the listed stock, so spend or fire projectiles to refresh them.

steps.text: At a @loc{Shrine}, open @mechanic{Make Offering} > @mechanic{Make an Offering} and donate items to earn Divine Rice.
At the same shrine open @mechanic{Make Offering} > @mechanic{Kodama Bazaar} and buy any listed item.

achievements.description: Completed 10 missions with NPCs or as Expeditions with other users. (Does not include Acolytes.)
achievements.summary: Complete 10 missions with NPC companions or as an online Expedition or Random Encounter.

guide.context: Acolytes summoned from Benevolent Graves do not count toward this achievement. Many side missions include an AI companion, so it can be finished without playing online.

steps.text: Play main and side missions that include an @npc{AI companion} until 10 missions have been completed.
Alternatively, open @loc{Starting Point} > @loc{Torii Gate}, start @mechanic{Expeditions} or @mechanic{Random Encounters}, and complete 10 missions.

achievements.description: Summoned an Acolyte from a Benevolent Grave 10 times.
achievements.summary: Summon 10 Acolytes from Benevolent Graves.

guide.context: A summon costs 2-5 Ochoko Cups. Cups drop from revenants at red graves and can be bought at the Kodama Bazaar, and Benevolent Graves also appear offline in most main missions.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{revenants} at red graves to collect @item{Ochoko Cups}.
Interact with a blue @loc{Benevolent Grave} to summon an Acolyte; repeat until you have summoned 10.

achievements.description: Completed your first Twilight mission.
achievements.summary: Complete one Twilight mission.

guide.context: Twilight missions unlock once the story reaches the second region and show up as red-eye icons along the world map's left edge. Only a main mission you have already cleared has a playable Twilight version.

steps.text: On the @loc{World Map}, pick a red-eye @loc{Twilight mission} whose base mission you have already finished.
Complete the harder version of that mission.

achievements.description: Bathed in first hot spring.
achievements.summary: Bathe in any one of the 27 hot springs.

guide.context: The first hot spring is in @loc{The Beast Born of Smoke and Flames}, behind a yokai wall just before the boss.

steps.text: Interact with any @loc{hot spring} and bathe in it.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all 27 hot springs.

guide.context: Select any mission on the world map and press R1/RB to see how many hot springs you have already bathed in there.

achievements.description: Defeated all types of yokai.
achievements.summary: Defeat one of every yokai type in the game.

guide.context: Small yokai and large yokai are tracked separately in the title records. @enemy{Kashin Koji} counts as a yokai only on patched versions, so defeat him again if you fought him on an older save.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > @loc{Titles} > @loc{Gameplay Record} to see which small and large yokai are still missing.
Find and defeat each missing yokai in its mission, replaying missions through mission select as needed.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama.
achievements.summary: Collect all 150 Kodama.

guide.context: Every five Kodama adds +1 Elixir on respawn, up to 8, and completing a region's set grants +25% Amrita.

steps.text: Equip an accessory or the @npc{Tengen Kujaku} Guardian Spirit with the @mechanic{Kodama sensor} effect to mark Kodama on the map.
Search every main and side mission for the small green @item{Kodama} and guide each one back to its shrine.
Select a mission on the @loc{World Map} and press R1/RB to confirm its Kodama are all found.

achievements.description: Collected all Guardian Spirits.
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Guardian Spirits.

guide.context: Every Guardian Spirit is a reward from a main or side mission, so New Game+ is not needed. The last is usually @npc{Itokuri} from @loc{Master of the Three Evils}, which unlocks with 120,000 dual-sword proficiency.

steps.text: Complete all 20 main missions and all 53 side missions to collect every Guardian Spirit reward.
Raise dual-sword proficiency to 120,000, clear @loc{Master of the Three Evils}, and claim @npc{Itokuri}.

achievements.description: Exchanged gifts with a Sudama for the first time.
achievements.summary: Give an item to a Sudama and take the gift it drops.

guide.context: The first Sudama is in @loc{The Beast Born of Smoke and Flames}: after the bridge past the burning village, climb down through the ladder inside the second wooden house.

steps.text: Find the purple @enemy{Sudama} in the underground room of the second wooden house.
Open your inventory and drop an unwanted @item{weapon} or other item near the Sudama; it picks the gift up automatically and leaves items in return.

achievements.description: Obtained your first Soul Core.
achievements.summary: Purify your first Soul Core at a shrine.

guide.context: The achievement does not unlock when the core drops, only after the core has been purified.

steps.text: Defeat a strong enemy until it drops a red-heart @item{Soul Core}, carry it to a @loc{Shrine}, and purify it.

achievements.description: Obtained a Kodama's Soul Core.
achievements.summary: Receive a Kodama Soul Core from a Sudama.

guide.context: Give a Soul Core to a Sudama for a chance at a Kodama Soul Core in return. Higher-level cores and Mortal Cores appear to improve the odds.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Sudama} in any mission.
Drop a @item{Soul Core} near it, and keep offering cores until it returns a @item{Kodama Soul Core}.

achievements.description: Obtained all Soul Cores.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 51 Soul Cores.

guide.context: Most cores drop from the enemy with the same name, so a full playthrough plus cleanup leaves only a few rare ones. Drop rates rise inside Dark Realms, and the Yamabushi Kodama blessing adds +5% to core drops. Keep one of each core and never fuse or discard it; duplicate types are safe to remove.

steps.text: Open the Soul Core menu, sort by Type, and compare your collection against the 51 cores.

Collect the special cores: @enemy{Nurikabe} by killing it, @enemy{Mujina} by imitating its gesture, @enemy{Toxic Slime} from the poison pools of @loc{The Viper's Sanctum}, @enemy{Kodama} from a Sudama trade, @enemy{Scampuss} as a reward after its timer expires, and the @item{Mortal} Blue, Red and Purple cores from human enemies and bosses.

Farm the rare cores: the Oni-Bi trio in @loc{Abduction}, @enemy{Karakasa Umbrella} in @loc{The Mysterious One Night Castle} or @loc{An Error in Calculation}, @enemy{Scampuss} in @loc{Dark Omens} or @loc{Stray Cats}, @enemy{Lesser Umi-Bozu} in @loc{Stray Cats}, and @enemy{Toxic Slime} in @loc{Hidetatsu's Dying Wish}.

achievements.description: Fused any Soul Core until it reached rank 9.
achievements.summary: Fuse a Soul Core up to rank 9.

guide.context: Fusing a core with the same type, or a Mortal Core with anything, adds 2 ranks, so about four fusions take a fresh core to the rank 9 maximum.

steps.text: At a @loc{Shrine}, open @mechanic{Manage Soul Cores} > @mechanic{Soul Fusion}.
Repeatedly fuse a common core such as @item{Enki} or @item{Gaki} with duplicates of its type or with @item{Mortal Cores} until its @mechanic{Soul Core Rank} reaches 9.

achievements.description: Discovered 10 hidden items on the map.
achievements.summary: Discover 10 hidden items on the world map.

guide.context: About 35 hidden items exist, roughly five per region, but only 10 are needed. They appear only when the map cursor is moved close enough for the spot to turn red, starting in the Awakening and Soaring regions.

steps.text: Open the @loc{World Map} for the Awakening or Soaring region.
Move the cursor across the region until a spot turns red, then press the button to reveal the hidden item; repeat in both regions until 10 are found.

achievements.description: Dispelled every instance of the Dark Realm in the main missions.
achievements.summary: Dispel all 47 Dark Realms that appear in the main missions.

guide.context: Dark Realms are the grey fog areas where the world turns black and white and Ki recovers slowly. Inside one, only the enemy ringed by red particles must die to dispel it, and a cleared realm stays cleared even if you die.

steps.text: Enter each main mission and fully explore it to find every grey @mechanic{Dark Realm}.
Inside a Dark Realm, defeat the enemy with red particles orbiting it.
Select a mission on the @loc{World Map} and press R1/RB to confirm no Dark Realms remain.

achievements.description: Defeated Mezuki and Gozuki in the same mission.
achievements.summary: Defeat Mezuki and Gozuki together in @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms}.

guide.context: @enemy{Gozuki} is an optional bull enemy near the mission start and @enemy{Mezuki} is the mission boss. Both count even if defeated at different times, because Gozuki stays dead after you respawn.

steps.text: Defeat the optional @enemy{Gozuki} near the start of @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms}.
Then finish the mission by defeating the boss @enemy{Mezuki}.

achievements.description: Became Ryunojo the Dung Lover's best friend and received the Coiled Snake Helmet smithing text.
achievements.summary: Give 30 Dungballs to Ryunojo the Dung Lover in @loc{Bird in a Cage}.

guide.context: A @item{Noble Dungball} counts as 2. Dungballs drop from @enemy{Tesso} enemies at roughly one per five kills and from corpses; the reward is the @item{Coiled Snake Helmet} smithing text.

steps.text: In @loc{Bird in a Cage}, pass the second shrine and go left into the poison-pool cave, climbing the ladder at the far end to reach @npc{Ryunojo}.
Collect 30 @item{Dungballs} from corpses and by killing @enemy{Tesso} enemies.
Hand the Dungballs to @npc{Ryunojo} until he calls you his best friend.

achievements.description: Encountered all the Usura-Hicho in "The Frenzied Blaze".
achievements.summary: Interact with all three Usura-Hicho in @loc{The Frenzied Blaze}.

guide.context: The Usura-Hicho are glowing blue butterfly swarms.

collectibles.name: First Dark Realm
collectibles.location: Inside the first Dark Realm area.
collectibles.method: Interact with the glowing blue @enemy{Usura-Hicho} swarm.

collectibles.name: After the second shrine
collectibles.location: In a side area after the second shrine, before the samurai joins your team.
collectibles.method: Interact with the glowing blue @enemy{Usura-Hicho} swarm.

collectibles.name: Before the third shrine
collectibles.location: In a side area on the right shortly before the third shrine, the last Dark Realm before the boss.
collectibles.method: Interact with the glowing blue @enemy{Usura-Hicho} swarm.

achievements.description: Destroyed every Amrita shard in "The High-spirited Demon".
achievements.summary: Destroy all six Amrita shards in @loc{The High-spirited Demon}.

guide.context: The shards damage you when you stand near them.

collectibles.name: Under the first shrine
collectibles.location: On the cliff beneath the first shrine.

collectibles.name: Kamaitachi woods
collectibles.location: Down the left side of the first village, in the woods with the @enemy{Kamaitachi} miniboss.

collectibles.name: First Dark Realm
collectibles.location: Across the tree stump behind the second shard's area.

collectibles.name: Rooftop room
collectibles.location: Open the right-hand gate in the cannonball area, cross the rooftop, and drop into the room below.

collectibles.name: Third Dark Realm
collectibles.location: In the third Dark Realm reached by crossing the trunk; run straight on from the fourth shard.

collectibles.name: Boulder wall
collectibles.location: Behind the wall broken by the last rolling boulder before the boss.

achievements.description: Defeated the boss of "The Viper's Sanctum" without breaking the statue of Shirohami.
achievements.summary: Defeat @loc{The Viper's Sanctum}'s boss without shattering any statue of @loc{Shirohami}.

guide.context: The three snake statues normally drain the poison pools and make the fight easier, so the poison stays active for this achievement. Replay the mission while overleveled to make it manageable.

steps.text: Enter @loc{The Viper's Sanctum} and leave all three @loc{snake statues} intact.
Reach and defeat the boss with the poison pools still present; use @item{Anti-toxin Pill II} and a @item{Rejuvenation Talisman} if you need to.

achievements.description: Defeated each of the Seven Spears in "Cherry Blossom Viewing in Daigo".
achievements.summary: Defeat all Seven Spears during @loc{Cherry Blossom Viewing in Daigo}.

guide.context: The Seven Spears are unique human enemies in distinct armour spread through the mission. You cannot backtrack to the start, and the achievement unlocks during the boss cutscene, so clear each area fully before advancing.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Cherry Blossom Viewing in Daigo} and defeat each of the seven unique-armour @enemy{spear warriors}, finishing one area before moving on.

achievements.description: Drove back every Tatarimokke along the journey in "A Way Out".
achievements.summary: Destroy both red orbs in the searchlight areas of @loc{A Way Out}.

guide.context: Letting a searchlight detect you spawns a large red orb, and destroying the orb dismisses the searchlight. Both are on the path toward the boss.

steps.text: In @loc{A Way Out}, walk into a searchlight beam to be detected, then destroy the red orb that appears.
Repeat at the second searchlight area; the achievement unlocks immediately after the second orb.

achievements.description: Defeated Gozuki in "The Village of Cursed Blossoms".
achievements.summary: Defeat Gozuki during @loc{The Village of Cursed Blossoms}.

guide.context: @enemy{Gozuki} is the bull enemy with the spiked club a short way into the mission and is far stronger than the surrounding enemies.

steps.text: Lower @enemy{Gozuki}'s Ki with high-stance attacks, counter his red-aura moves, and fire @item{Soul Core} attacks as his Ki bar nears empty.
Finish him while he is staggered; the achievement unlocks on his death.

achievements.description: Got Gyuki to attack the dam in "Pervading Waters".
achievements.summary: Make Gyuki charge into the dam during the @loc{Pervading Waters} boss fight.

guide.context: The fight begins after @enemy{Saika Magoichi}, when you drop into Gyuki's arena. The achievement can unlock even if the charge kills you, but retrying later means beating Saika again.

steps.text: When the @enemy{Gyuki} fight starts, stand against the @loc{dam wall} where you dropped in and hold block.
Wait for @enemy{Gyuki} to charge into the dam behind you.

achievements.description: Rang all the bells in "Ruin Draws Near".
achievements.summary: Ring all six bells in @loc{Ruin Draws Near}.

guide.context: Ring each bell by hitting it with a strong attack until it falls.

collectibles.name: First Dark Realm
collectibles.location: Inside the first Dark Realm.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

collectibles.name: Second Dark Realm
collectibles.location: Inside the second Dark Realm.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

collectibles.name: Basement, room one
collectibles.location: Backtrack from the second Dark Realm to the basement of a building; the bell is in the first room.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

collectibles.name: Basement, room two
collectibles.location: In the room connected to the third bell.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

collectibles.name: Third shrine floor
collectibles.location: In the Dark Realm after the third shrine, on the shrine's own floor.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

collectibles.name: Third shrine ground floor
collectibles.location: In the Dark Realm after the third shrine, on the ground floor.
collectibles.method: Hit the @item{bell} with strong attacks until it falls.

achievements.description: Completed "A Song to Calm the Storm".
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{A Song to Calm the Storm}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{A Song to Calm the Storm} in the Tengu's Disciple DLC.

achievements.description: Completed "Eternal Rivals".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{Eternal Rivals}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Eternal Rivals} in the Tengu's Disciple DLC.

achievements.description: Completed "Shadows Creep in Kurama".
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Shadows Creep in Kurama}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Shadows Creep in Kurama} in the Tengu's Disciple DLC.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in "The Tengu's Disciple".
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama in @loc{The Tengu's Disciple}.

guide.context: The 25 are split 10 in @loc{A Song to Calm the Storm}, 6 in @loc{Shadows Creep in Kurama} and 9 in @loc{Eternal Rivals}. A Kodama sensor item marks them on the map.

steps.text: Equip a piece of gear with the @mechanic{Kodama sensor} effect.
Search all three DLC missions for the green @item{Kodama} and guide each one back to its shrine.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the splitstaff.
achievements.summary: Acquire the splitstaff's mystic art by reaching 120,000 splitstaff proficiency and clearing its Veteran dojo mission.

guide.context: The splitstaff arrives with The Tengu's Disciple and follows the same rules as the base weapons: 120,000 proficiency, the Veteran dojo mission, then a skill-tree purchase. @loc{The Golden Castle} in New Game+ is a fast proficiency farm.

steps.text: Deal damage with the splitstaff until its @mechanic{proficiency} reaches 120,000; check it at Touchpad > @loc{Status}.
Clear the splitstaff's Veteran dojo mission once it appears.
Open Touchpad > @mechanic{Learn Skills} and buy the splitstaff mystic art.

achievements.description: Collected all of Saigyo's poetry cards.
achievements.summary: Collect all three of Saigyo's poetry cards.

guide.context: All three cards are looted from corpses.

collectibles.name: A Song to Calm the Storm
collectibles.location: At the camp before the first boss, where the Bakegani hide in the sand.
collectibles.method: Loot the @item{poetry card} from the corpse.

collectibles.name: Eternal Rivals
collectibles.location: On the corpse guarded by @enemy{Mezuki} before the last shrine; search the left side of the area.
collectibles.method: Loot the @item{poetry card} from the corpse.

collectibles.name: Shadows Creep in Kurama
collectibles.location: Climb the ladder before the last shrine, keep left, and check the house beside the yokai cloud.
collectibles.method: Loot the @item{poetry card} from the corpse.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring found in "The Tengu's Disciple".
achievements.summary: Bathe in all three hot springs in @loc{The Tengu's Disciple}.

collectibles.name: A Song to Calm the Storm
collectibles.location: Inside the first DLC main mission.

collectibles.name: Shadows Creep in Kurama
collectibles.location: Inside the sub mission.

collectibles.name: Eternal Rivals
collectibles.location: Inside the second DLC main mission.

achievements.description: Used all the giant bows in "A Song to Calm the Storm".
achievements.summary: Use all three giant bows in @loc{A Song to Calm the Storm}.

guide.context: The giant bows are fixed emplacements that damage the boss.

collectibles.name: Ship, upper floor
collectibles.location: On the top floor of a ship before the Benkei fight.
collectibles.method: Interact with the @item{giant bow} and fire it.

collectibles.name: Second ship, upper floor
collectibles.location: On the top floor of another ship before the Benkei fight.
collectibles.method: Interact with the @item{giant bow} and fire it.

collectibles.name: After Benkei
collectibles.location: At the shrine after defeating Benkei, near the first Dark Realm.
collectibles.method: Interact with the @item{giant bow} and fire it.

achievements.description: Destroyed 150 of the golden Amrita shards found in the gold mine in "Eternal Rivals".
achievements.summary: Destroy 150 golden Amrita shards in the gold mine in @loc{Eternal Rivals}.

guide.context: The golden shards exist only inside the mine area, so clear them before leaving it.

steps.text: In @loc{Eternal Rivals}, enter the gold mine and destroy the golden @item{Amrita shards} until you have broken 150.

achievements.description: Used an attack to knock Yoshitsune off his perch on the bridge in "Eternal Rivals".
achievements.summary: Knock Yoshitsune off his bridge perch in @loc{Eternal Rivals} with an attack.

guide.context: A ranged weapon is the practical way to hit the perch from the ground.

steps.text: When @npc{Yoshitsune} stands on a perch in @loc{Eternal Rivals}, shoot him with a @item{rifle} or @item{hand cannon} to knock him off the bridge.

achievements.description: Completed picture scroll missions 10 times.
achievements.summary: Complete picture scroll missions 10 times.

guide.context: Picture scrolls drop during play, and killing the revenant at a red-and-white grave guarantees one.

steps.text: Collect @item{picture scrolls} from drops or by defeating the revenant at a red-and-white grave.
Complete a picture scroll mission 10 times.

achievements.description: Completed "Suzune in the Flames".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{Suzune in the Flames}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Suzune in the Flames} in the Darkness in the Capital DLC.

achievements.description: Completed "The Blighted Gate".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Blighted Gate}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Blighted Gate} in the Darkness in the Capital DLC.

achievements.description: Completed "Palace of the Damned".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{Palace of the Damned}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Palace of the Damned} in the Darkness in the Capital DLC.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in "Darkness in the Capital".
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama across @loc{Darkness in the Capital}.

guide.context: The 25 are split 8 in @loc{Palace of the Damned}, 2 in @loc{Suzune in the Flames}, 9 in @loc{The Blighted Gate} and 6 in @loc{The Buddha's Palm}. A Kodama sensor item marks them on the map.

steps.text: Equip a piece of gear with the @mechanic{Kodama sensor} effect.
Search all four DLC missions for the green @item{Kodama} and guide each one back to its shrine.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the fists.
achievements.summary: Acquire the fists' mystic art by reaching 120,000 fists proficiency and clearing their Veteran dojo mission.

guide.context: The fists arrive with Darkness in the Capital and follow the base weapon rules: 120,000 proficiency, the Veteran dojo mission, then a skill-tree purchase. @loc{The Golden Castle} in New Game+ is a fast proficiency farm.

steps.text: Deal damage with the fists until their @mechanic{proficiency} reaches 120,000; check it at Touchpad > @loc{Status}.
Clear the fists' Veteran dojo mission once it appears.
Open Touchpad > @mechanic{Learn Skills} and buy the fists mystic art.

achievements.displayName: The Flame That Lights the Darkness
achievements.description: Lit all fire altars in "Palace of the Damned".
achievements.summary: Light all five fire altars in @loc{Palace of the Damned}.

guide.context: Check the top floors of the buildings, including the altar on the roof just before the Nue fight.

steps.text: In @loc{Palace of the Damned}, find and light all five @item{fire altars}.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring found in "Darkness in the Capital".
achievements.summary: Bathe in all four hot springs in @loc{Darkness in the Capital}.

collectibles.name: Palace of the Damned
collectibles.location: Behind a yokai wall in the main mission.

collectibles.name: The Blighted Gate
collectibles.location: Inside the main mission.

collectibles.name: The Demon Slayers
collectibles.location: Inside the sub mission.

collectibles.name: The Buddha's Palm
collectibles.location: Inside the sub mission.

achievements.description: Completed "The Dragon's Kin".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Dragon's Kin}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{The Dragon's Kin} in the Darkness in the Capital DLC.

achievements.description: Defeated Tsuchigumo while equipped with at least one piece of gear with the special effect "Dragon Ninja".
achievements.summary: Defeat Tsuchigumo in @loc{The Blighted Gate} while wearing at least one piece of gear with the @item{Dragon Ninja} effect.

guide.context: Farm Dragon Ninja gear from @loc{The Dragon Clan}. Only one equipped piece with the effect is required.

steps.text: Farm @item{Dragon Ninja} equipment in @loc{The Dragon Clan} and equip at least one piece.
In @loc{The Blighted Gate}, defeat the boss @enemy{Tsuchigumo} while wearing that gear.

achievements.description: Caused Oboroguruma to release Amrita from its carriage at least 10 times.
achievements.summary: Make Oboroguruma release Amrita from its carriage 10 times.

guide.context: Match your stance to the golden weak point: horns use high stance, eyes use mid stance and tongue uses low stance. A burst counter also has a chance to force the release regardless of stance.

steps.text: Farm the @enemy{Oboroguruma} in @loc{Suzune in the Flames}, reached by running through the fire beside the starting shrine, and pray at the shrine to respawn it.
Attack its golden weak point in the matching stance, or burst counter it, until Amrita has spilled from its carriage 10 times.

achievements.description: Attained 100% Penitence on a Stone of Penance.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% Penitence on an active Stone of Penance.

guide.context: Enemies become stronger while the Stone of Penance is active. A bar shows its progress when you are clearing a level.

steps.text: At a @loc{Shrine}, open @mechanic{Stone of Penance}, offer an item, and receive and activate the stone.
Kill enemies with the stone active until its @mechanic{Penitence} reaches 100%.

achievements.description: Completed "Dawn of the Demon".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{Dawn of the Demon}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Dawn of the Demon} in The First Samurai DLC.

achievements.description: Completed "A Distant Dream".
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{A Distant Dream}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{A Distant Dream} in The First Samurai DLC.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in "The First Samurai".
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama in @loc{The First Samurai}.

guide.context: The 25 are split 10 in @loc{Dawn of the Demon}, 6 in the sub mission @loc{In Search of the Elixir} and 9 in @loc{A Distant Dream}. A Kodama sensor item marks them on the map.

steps.text: Equip a piece of gear with the @mechanic{Kodama sensor} effect.
Search the DLC missions for the green @item{Kodama} and guide each one back to its shrine.

achievements.description: Used a cask of holy water in "Dawn of the Demon" to damage an enemy's Ki.
achievements.summary: Damage an enemy's Ki with a cask of holy water in @loc{Dawn of the Demon}.

guide.context: The casks sit around the waterfall area, so an enemy is usually close enough to catch in the blast.

steps.text: In @loc{Dawn of the Demon}, approach a @item{cask of holy water} near the waterfall with an enemy close by and smash it.

achievements.description: Completed "The Alluring Ancient".
achievements.summary: Complete the sub mission @loc{The Alluring Ancient}.

guide.context: The mission is unlocked by clearing @loc{A Distant Dream} and collecting three grilled tang sweets: one in @loc{A Distant Dream}, one in @loc{Dawn of the Demon} and one in @loc{In Search of the Elixir}.

steps.text: Collect the three @item{grilled tang sweets} from the three First Samurai missions.
Complete the sub mission @loc{The Alluring Ancient} once it appears.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring found in "The First Samurai".
achievements.summary: Bathe in all five hot springs in @loc{The First Samurai}.

achievements.summary: Save all three Mujina in @loc{A Distant Dream}.

guide.context: A Mujina is saved by imitating the gesture it performs instead of attacking it.

collectibles.name: Slope and stone bridge
collectibles.location: Leaving the starting shrine, climb the slope and bear right to a small stone bridge by the first hot spring; continue on, then drop down on the left.
collectibles.method: Imitate the @enemy{Mujina}'s gesture to save it.

collectibles.name: Wooden building cell
collectibles.location: On the lower floor of the large wooden building, in a locked cell opened with the Prison Key from the @enemy{Konaki-Jiji}.
collectibles.method: Imitate the @enemy{Mujina}'s gesture to save it.

collectibles.name: Cabin by the boss shrine
collectibles.location: Head up the stairs near the shrine before the boss and look right for a small cabin.
collectibles.method: Imitate the @enemy{Mujina}'s gesture to save it.

achievements.description: Defeated the four demons in "A Distant Dream".
achievements.summary: Defeat the four demons in @loc{A Distant Dream}.

guide.context: The four demons appear in the story boss fight of the mission.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{A Distant Dream} and defeat all four @enemy{demons} in the mission's boss fight.

achievements.description: Completed "Against All Comers" on Dream of the Demon or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Against All Comers} on Dream of the Demon difficulty or higher.

guide.context: Dream of the Demon is the third playthrough difficulty, so this requires at least New Game++. The mission is a boss rush of enemies from every region and ends with @enemy{Otakemaru} fought twice.

steps.text: Unlock Dream of the Demon by completing the game on the previous difficulties.
In The First Samurai region, complete the side mission @loc{Against All Comers} on Dream of the Demon or higher.

achievements.description: Collected all of Kukai's brushes in "Words of Respite".
achievements.summary: Collect all of Kukai's brushes in the sub mission @loc{Words of Respite}.

guide.context: Returning one brush completes the mission, after which human enemies turn non-hostile and yokai despawn, leaving you free to gather the remaining three brushes.

steps.text: In @loc{Words of Respite}, collect and return one brush to the monk to finish the mission.
With the mission complete, collect the other three of @npc{Kukai}'s @item{brushes} from the now-quiet map.

achievements.description: Obtained the aid of Tokichiro, Minamoto no Yoshitsune, and Minamoto no Yorimitsu from a Benevolent Grave in "A Familiar Glow".
achievements.summary: Get the aid of Tokichiro, Minamoto no Yoshitsune, and Minamoto no Yorimitsu from the Benevolent Graves in @loc{A Familiar Glow}.

guide.context: The three summons cannot all be obtained in one visit, so treat each ally as a separate run through the sub mission.

steps.text: In the sub mission @loc{A Familiar Glow}, interact with a @loc{Benevolent Grave} to summon one of @npc{Tokichiro}, @npc{Minamoto no Yoshitsune} or @npc{Minamoto no Yorimitsu}.
Play the sub mission again and summon a different one of the three allies until all of them have lent you their aid.
